app.name: Government Scheme Assistant
home.title: Find government schemes that may apply to you
home.subtitle: Answer a few simple questions. Your answers are checked against the published rules of each scheme, and every result is explained.
home.step1_text: Type, tap an option, or speak. Any question can be skipped.
home.step2_text: Each scheme is checked against its published criteria, with the reasons shown.
home.step3_text: Get the list of documents and the official place to apply.
home.privacy: Your answers are kept in this browser. They are sent to our service and to Sarvam AI only to process your request, and are not stored on the server.
home.coverage: This service currently covers {count} central government schemes. State schemes are not included yet.
chat.title: Assistant
chat.greeting: Hello. I will ask a few questions to find government schemes that may apply to you.
chat.skip_note: Any question can be skipped. Nothing is shared beyond what is needed to check eligibility.
chat.input_placeholder: Type an answer or ask a question
chat.keep_answering: Answering more questions makes the results more precise.
chat.all_done: That is all the information needed. Your results are ready to view.
chat.restart_confirm: This deletes your answers and the conversation. Start over?
chat.no_speech: No speech was detected. Please try again.
chat.mic_denied: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings to use voice input.
chat.mic_unsupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser.
chat.speak_failed: The reply could not be read aloud.
q.age.why: Many schemes have minimum or maximum age limits.
q.gender.why: Some schemes are open only to women.
q.area.prompt: Do you live in a rural or an urban area?
q.area.why: Housing and several other schemes differ for villages and towns.
q.occupation.why: Many schemes are meant for farmers, students, artisans, street vendors and other groups.
q.annual_income.prompt: What is the approximate yearly income of your household?
q.annual_income.why: Some schemes have an income limit.
q.annual_income.hint: Total for the whole household, in rupees per year
q.category.prompt: Which social category does your family belong to?
q.category.why: Some scholarships and benefits are reserved for certain categories.
q.priority_household.prompt: Does your household have a BPL, Antyodaya (AAY) or priority-household ration card?
q.priority_household.why: Several welfare schemes are meant for households with this card.
q.owns_farmland.why: Farmer income support is linked to land ownership.
q.owns_pucca_house.prompt: Does your household already own a pucca (permanent) house?
q.owns_pucca_house.why: Housing schemes are for households without a pucca house.
q.has_lpg.prompt: Does your household already have an LPG gas connection?
q.has_lpg.why: A free connection is offered only to households that do not have one.
q.pays_income_tax.why: Income tax payers are excluded from several schemes.
q.govt_employee.why: Government employees are excluded from several schemes.
q.is_widow.why: A pension is available for widows from eligible households.
q.pregnant_or_lactating.why: A maternity benefit is available for pregnant and breastfeeding mothers.
q.daughters_under_10.prompt: How many daughters below 10 years of age do you have?
q.daughters_under_10.why: A savings scheme is available for girls below 10 years of age.
q.post_matric_student.prompt: Are you studying in Class 11 or above?
q.post_matric_student.why: The scholarship covers education after Class 10.
results.title: Schemes for you
results.subtitle: Based on the information you have provided.
results.gate_text: Results are shown only after we know enough about you. Nothing is recommended before that.
results.show_not_eligible: Show schemes that do not apply ({count})
results.hide_not_eligible: Hide schemes that do not apply
results.catalog_note: This list covers central government schemes only. Always confirm the details on the official website.
results.translation_notice: Some text is shown in English because translation is not available right now.
status_desc.eligible: Every criterion that can be checked is met.
status_desc.potentially_eligible: Every criterion that can be checked is met. Some conditions must still be confirmed with official records.
status_desc.insufficient_info: We cannot decide yet because some information is missing.
status_desc.not_eligible: At least one criterion is not met.
detail.not_ready: Answer the questions in the assistant to see how this scheme applies to you.
detail.documents_hint: Tick the documents you already have. This list is saved in this browser only.
detail.step1_text: Review your eligibility above and confirm any conditions that need official records.
detail.step2_text: Keep the documents listed above ready, with copies.
detail.step3_with_url: Apply, or read the official instructions, on the official website.
detail.verified_note: These details were compiled from published guidelines and may change. Confirm them on the official website before you apply.
